values: 邀请所有敌方英雄参与博弈，博弈失败者向埃德加支付属性并受到伤害。
Eryndor invites all enemy heroes to play his game. Enemies who lose the game surrender stats to Eryndor and take damage.

“邀请”所有非召唤物敌人参与埃德加的博弈，每名敌人各投掷1枚骰子并独立结算胜负。敌人每受到来自不同友军的属性降低效果时，永久叠加1层“厄运”，至多叠加3层。每层“厄运”使敌人投掷出的点数降低1点。当敌方点数小于等于3点时视为博弈失败，令其向埃德加支付其20% + 2%攻击力和15% + 1.5%生命上限，并对其造成3次160% ATK伤害。每名敌人至多向埃德加支付3次属性，埃德加通过该效果获得的攻击力和生命上限不超过自身对应属性的100% + 10%。

Eryndor invites all non-summoned enemies to play his game. Each enemy independently rolls a die to determine their outcome.
Whenever a different ally inflicts a stat reduction effect on an enemy, that enemy permanently gains 1 stack of Woe, stacking up to 3 times. Each stack of Woe reduces the enemy's roll by 1.
If the final roll is 3 or lower, the enemy loses the game, surrendering 20% + 2% of their ATK and 15% + 1.5% of their max HP to Eryndor and taking 160% ATK damage 3 times.
Eryndor can claim stats from each enemy up to 3 times. The total ATK and max HP Eryndor gains this way cannot exceed 100% + 10% of his corresponding stats.
博弈失败的敌人每次受到的伤害提升至170% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt to an enemy who loses Eryndor's game to 170% ATK.
博弈失败的敌人每次受到的伤害提升至180% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt to an enemy who loses Eryndor's game to 180% ATK.
博弈失败的敌人每次受到的伤害提升至190% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt to an enemy who loses Eryndor's game to 190% ATK.
博弈失败的敌人每次受到的伤害提升至200% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt to an enemy who loses Eryndor's game to 200% ATK.
使用折扇扇叶依次攻击所有非召唤物敌人，并根据敌人的“厄运”层数提升伤害。
Eryndor strikes all non-summoned enemies with his fan blades, dealing more damage for each stack of Woe on the target.
按当前生命比例从低到高的顺序，朝非召唤物敌人依次发射总计9枚折扇扇叶，每枚扇叶造成70% + 10% ATK伤害。目标每有1层“厄运”，本技能造成伤害额外提高10% + 1%。

Eryndor unleashes 9 fan blades to strike non-summoned enemies in order from lowest to highest HP percentage, dealing 70% + 10% ATK damage per blade. Each stack of Woe on a target further increases the damage they take from this skill by 10% + 1%.
Increases the damage of each hit to 75% + 10% ATK.
Increases the damage of each hit to 80% + 10% ATK.
Increases the damage of each hit to 85% + 10% ATK.
扔出折扇持续攻击敌人最密集区域并获得护盾。
Eryndor throws his fan into the area with the most enemies, dealing continuous damage and gaining shields.
朝最密集的敌方区域扔出旋转的折扇并获得可抵御300% ATK伤害的护盾，随后在1.5秒内，对其周围1格内敌人造成4次170% + 20% ATK伤害。随后收回折扇，额外获得此次技能实际造成伤害20% + 2%的护盾。本技能提供的护盾持续8秒。

Eryndor throws a spinning fan into the area with the most enemies and gains a shield that absorbs 300% ATK damage. The fan remains in that area for 1.5s, dealing 170% + 20% ATK damage 4 times to enemies within 1 tile. Upon the fan's return, Eryndor gains an extra shield equal to 20% + 2% of the actual damage dealt by this skill. Shields granted by this skill last for 8s.
提高自身急速，若有敌人在博弈中失败额外提升急速。
Eryndor increases his Haste, with an additional increase when an enemy loses his game.
战斗中，埃德加提高10点急速，若有敌人在博弈中失败，额外提高6点急速。
Eryndor gains 10 Haste during battle. When an enemy loses his game, he gains an extra 6 Haste.
战斗中，埃德加提高14点急速，若有敌人在博弈中失败，额外提高7点急速。
Eryndor gains 14 Haste during battle. When an enemy loses his game, he gains an extra 7 Haste.
战斗中，埃德加提高18点急速，若有敌人在博弈中失败，额外提高8点急速。
Eryndor gains 18 Haste during battle. When an enemy loses his game, he gains an extra 8 Haste.
博弈失败的敌人将会受到若干次额外伤害。
Enemies who lose Eryndor's game take extra damage multiple times.
释放终极技能时，若敌人博弈失败，埃德加在结算时额外对其造成1次200% ATK伤害。此后每次失败使该技能伤害次数增加1次，至多造成3次伤害。

When Eryndor uses his Ultimate, if an enemy loses his game, his Ultimate lands 1 extra hit that deals 200% ATK damage to that enemy. Each subsequent loss by that enemy increases the number of extra hits they take by 1, up to 3 hits.
Increases the damage dealt by extra hits to 225% ATK.
非首领敌人在博弈中累计失败2次时，使其在本局战斗的剩余时间内永久失去所有属性增益效果，攻击力额外降低埃德加攻击力的15%，至多使目标攻击力降低至其初始值的20%。

Once a non-boss enemy has lost Eryndor's game 2 times, they are permanently stripped of all stat buffs for the rest of the battle, and their ATK is further reduced by 15% of Eryndor's ATK, down to a minimum of 20% of the target's initial ATK.
Increases the damage dealt by extra hits to 250% ATK.
战斗开始时收取敌方英雄的基础属性作为入场费用。
Eryndor collects a portion of enemy heroes' basic stats as an entry fee when a battle starts.
战斗开始时，埃德加收取所有非召唤物敌人7%基础属性作为入场费用，收取总值不超过自身对应属性的35%。
When a battle starts, Eryndor collects 7% of every non-summoned enemy's basic stats as an entry fee. The total amount collected for each stat cannot exceed 35% of Eryndor's corresponding stat.
